earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: Reported net sales for the third quarter were $1.94 billion, an increase of 4% versus the prior-year period.
Adjusted EPS excluding amortization 2 was $0.83 per diluted share.

On a comparable basis 3 , currency neutral sales 2 increased 5% versus the prior-year period led by broad-based growth including mid-single digit performances in Scent and Taste and low-single digit growth in Health & Biosciences.
On a comparable basis 3 , currency neutral adjusted operating EBITDA 2 improved 6% versus the prior-year period, driven by volume growth.

quotes.text: IFF delivered a solid third quarter, with improved sales and profitability across all divisions.

outlook: The Company now expects full year 2026 sales to be in the range of $7.5 billion to $7.6 billion (versus $7.4 billion to $7.6 billion previously).
For the full year 2026 adjusted operating EBITDA is now expected to be in the range of $1.55 billion to $1.60 billion (versus $1.53 billion to $1.60 billion previously).

On a continuing operations basis, the Company now expects comparable currency neutral sales growth to be between 3% to 4% (versus 2% to 4% previously), and comparable currency neutral adjusted operating EBITDA growth to be 5% to 8% (versus 4% to 8% previously).

Based on recent market foreign exchange rates, the Company continues to expect that foreign exchange will have an approximately 1% positive impact on sales growth and have an approximately 2% positive impact on adjusted operating EBITDA growth in 2026.
